summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 14, 2026, along with proxy materials and a CEO letter. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a routine notice of an annual meeting for the re-election of directors and other standard proposals.
